_doc: 012/P1-5 COMMITTED deterministic baseline for tests/fixtures/uat/golden_corpus.json. These are measured, fixed values (NOT self-derived via baseline_from_run) so cross-commit quality drift is detectable. min_metrics are release-blocking floors; max_metrics are ceilings. p95_latency_ms is intentionally a generous ceiling only (latency is environment-dependent, not deterministic). precision_at_k=0.2 reflects precision@k with top_k=5 and one relevant doc per item (structural max 1/5); recall/mrr/citation/groundedness/faithfulness are 1.0 because each query's unique-token target is retrieved at rank 1 and the extractive answer is faithful by construction.
